01 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE PIXELS

I’m a generative AI art and workflow specialist, a Senior 3D Artist at Fortis, and 18 years into making things for games. My biggest skill is crossing disciplines: connecting software, 3D, 2D, animation, and photography to find new ways to create.

GENERATIVE / EXPLORATIONS

BEKO / FROM IDEA TO FILM

Starting with a set of storyboards, I brought this BEKO oven ad to life with Claude, Blender, and generative image, video, and sound tools. I used 3D layouts to shape the camera angles and timing, then built the shots into a finished film. A little structure, a lot of iteration, and one kitchen that had to feel like the same place from start to finish.

  • Claude
  • Blender
  • Python
  • Photoshop
  • Gemini

VICTORIAN HOUSE / AI GENERATION

Starting from a single street photo of a San Francisco Victorian, I rebuilt the house and its block in 3D with Claude driving Blender, plus a few generative image tools for skies, reflections and ornament detail. I matched the camera to the photo first, then layered in light, materials, trees and all the small imperfections that make a street feel lived in. A lot of side-by-side comparisons, a lot of tiny fixes, and one facade that had to hold up next to the real thing.

  • Blender
  • Claude
  • Gemini
  • Python

MIDJOURNEY / EXPERIMENTAL FASHION

A little fashion editorial, a little future fiction. I used Midjourney to explore unexpected silhouettes, sculptural details, and worlds that feel just out of reach. The stills set the mood; the motion experiments take it somewhere new.

These explorations also found a home in EVANCE ↗, my fashion-focused website project.
